rows.note: Use this colloquial expression for a whole lifetime or a hyperbolically long time, especially when saying that something has taken ages.

example.english: You’ve been at it for eternity and still haven’t submitted the report?
example.traditional: 你搞咗成世，份報告仲未交？
example.jyutping: nei5 gaau2 zo2 seng4 sai3 fan6 bou3 gou3 zung6 mei6 gaau1

rows.note: Use this formal abstract noun for literal endless existence or existence beyond time; it is the all-purpose choice for these two senses.

example.english: The poet believes that love can transcend time and reach eternity.
example.traditional: 詩人相信愛可以超越時間，走向永恆。
example.jyutping: si1 jan4 soeng1 seon3 oi3 ho2 ji5 ciu1 jyut6 si4 gaan3 zau2 hoeng3 wing5 hang4
